criterion_semantics: Engineering screening tolerance fixed before model evaluation; not measurement uncertainty or NIST acceptance criterion
calibration: none; no parameter fitting or point exclusion based on model residuals
scope: Steady single-phase straight copper pipe; all four plotted repeat series. No plant, transient, two-phase, thermal or neutron validation
uncertainty_semantics: No complete per-point experimental uncertainty budget available in the figure; do not infer it from the plotted Colebrook +/-3 percent comparison band
digitization_semantics: Vector symbol bounding-box midpoint; full half-symbol extent plus 0.01 form coordinate unit as conservative coordinate-reading bounds, not probabilistic confidence intervals
acceptance: Each symbol center must meet max_relative_error; envelope sensitivity reported separately and cannot convert a failed center criterion to pass
status_policy: Experimental comparison only; validated=false and plant_referenced=false regardless of screening outcome
